name: Recital H
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: whereas China is a decisive enabler of Russia’s illegal and unprovoked war of aggression against Ukraine, serving as the largest provider of dual-use goods and helping it circumvent sanctions; whereas without China’s and other countries' support, Russia would not be able to wage its war of aggression against Ukraine to the same extent or with the same force; whereas China’s diplomatic, economic, and material support to Russia’s war of aggression, including the supply of dual use items used in military supply chains, violates the UN Charter and China's own narrative of neutrality, including China’s own Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence;
